verdict.rationale: Notte's own docs say every session automatically gets clean, realistic browser fingerprints and built-in stealth features against anti-bot systems. The docs and site also offer residential proxies (global network, fixed IPs, bring-your-own) that can be combined with stealth mode. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of geo-targeting or country selection and of how proxies are configured per session, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that stealth and proxies actually avoid blocks.
